title: unforged main CI red: v1_1_exit_gates phase_2 (Mach-O Class 1) + caos_worker1 namespace-sandbox exec_counter path
body:
Repo softmax-universe/unforged, main 1e30ef5. The CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) is red on main, independent of PR #12:

1. Core job (main run 45923997544, job 140261007609): tests/v1_1_exit_gates.rs:509 `phase_2_exit_gate_git_namespace_four_class_execve_macho_sigtrap_and_crash_stash` panics `expected native Mach-O Class 1 target` on ubuntu runner.
2. Coglet job (job 140261007562), UNFORGED_CAOS_SANDBOX=namespace step: tests/caos_unforged_runner.rs `caos_worker1_jobs_execute_as_two_parent_unforged_git_merges_and_compose_downstream` fails: worker run_worker line 12 writes host path /tmp/unforged_caos_runner_e2e_merge_flow_runner_os_*/exec_counter.log which does not exist inside the namespace sandbox.

Same two failures reproduce on PR #12 head 388228e (run 45946534231 rerun jobs 140346954788 / 140346954454). Also seen once: core job hung 41 min in tests/real_tty_ssh.rs after the first test (first attempt job 140332398680), passed on rerun — possible flake.

Fix the tests/fixtures (not production safety checks) so main CI is green; open PR, get independent review, merge with exact-head CI green. Do not weaken sandbox or exit-gate assertions without justification.

human_request.action: Allow a production cache-publication fix to finish making Unforged CI green. Unblock = A (fix and verify); archive = B (stop without merging PR #13).
human_request.why_human: Tried: the fixture fixes passed hosted Linux and namespace tests; independent feasibility review ruled out a fixture-only repair for the macOS permission failure. Only you can: change the explicit tests/fixtures-only scope limit to permit production cache-publication changes; no safety assertions will be weakened.
human_request.scope:
Situation: The two reported test failures are fixed, but restoring the retired Mac runner exposed a production bug publishing read-only cache directories. CI remains red and the PR is not merged.
Options:
A) Fix production publication: preserve read-only publication, add regressions, review and rerun CI; additional agent work, reversible PR changes.
B) Stop without merging: leave the fixes in the open PR and macOS CI red; no further work, resume later if desired.
Recommend: A - fixes the real Mac bug without hiding failures or relaxing sandbox protections.
